verdict.rationale: Cerebras offers a Cloud Console playground for trying models with no key or install. It also gives $5 in free credits to "prototype prompts, agents, and real-time apps", and the console manages separate projects and API keys. Together these give a loose way to experiment apart from production integrations. None of it is documented as a dedicated sandbox or test-mode environment isolated from production data. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test environment or test-mode API keys, documented isolation of test traffic from production data/projects, and independent or hands-on corroboration of such separation.
